description: This Java source file defines the KafkaEdqsQueueFactory class, which implements the EdqsQueueFactory interface. It provides methods to create Kafka consumers and producers for handling EDQS (Edge Data Queue Service) messages, including configuration and setup for different topics and administrative tasks within the Thingsboard platform.

classes.name: KafkaEdqsQueueFactory
classes.description: A factory class for creating Kafka consumers and producers for EDQS topics, managing configurations and administrative tasks within the Thingsboard platform.

methods.name: createEdqsEventsConsumer
methods.description: Creates a Kafka consumer for EDQS events.

methods.name: createEdqsEventsToBackupConsumer
methods.description: Creates a Kafka consumer for EDQS events backup.

methods.name: createEdqsStateConsumer
methods.description: Creates a Kafka consumer for EDQS state messages.

methods.name: createEdqsMsgConsumer
methods.description: Helper method to create a Kafka consumer with specified parameters.

methods.name: createEdqsStateProducer
methods.description: Creates a Kafka producer for EDQS state messages.

methods.name: createEdqsResponseTemplate
methods.description: Creates a response template for EDQS request-response handling.

methods.name: getEdqsQueueAdmin
methods.description: Returns the Kafka admin instance for EDQS queue management.
